@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+---

+title: 'ROUTER-3: Each session that a router vends registers in its directory (new, subagent, fork, restored)'
+---
+## Goal
+Every session that a profile of a router vends (new root, subagent, fork, restored root and restored forks) is in `router.sessionDirectory` with the right kind and parent, and leaves the live list when it closes.
+
+## Spec
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-router.md#router-3-session-directory ("Each session that the router vends ... registers itself"; D87 leaves the how to the implementation)
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/session.md sections 2 (the vend points), 5.2 and 7 (Q37)
+
+## What
+- **Q37 answer (the link from a profile to its router):** today a profile cannot reach its `Router`. `RoutedModel` (`/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/LanguageModelProfile.swift`) holds `routerId`, `recorder`, `hooks` and so on, but no router. Add a `sessionDirectory: RouterSessionDirectory?` to `RoutedModel`'s init, passed by `Router.resolve` in `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Router.swift` the same way it passes `hooks`. A hand-built profile with no router gives `nil`, and its sessions register nowhere.
+- Register at each vend point, before the session is returned (the `nonisolated` synchronous `register` of the directory card):
+  - `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedLLM.swift` internal `makeSession(...)`: kind `subagent` when `parentCall` or `agentSpawn` is set (parent id = `parentCall?.sessionID ?? agentSpawn?.parentSessionId`), else `root`.
+  - `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorForking.swift` `fork(workingDirectory:)`: kind `fork`, parent id = the source session.
+  - `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/SessionTreeRestoration.swift` `restoreSessionTree`: the restored root (kind from its sidecar: `agentSpawn` gives `subagent`) and each restored fork (`fork`).
+- `close()` (`RoutedSessionActorForking.swift`, `func close() async`) unregisters the session, so a closed session leaves the live list even while a host still holds it.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: a session from `router.resolve(...).standard.makeSession(configuration:)` is in `router.sessionDirectory.sessions(matching:)` with kind `root`.
+- [ ] Add the `RoutedModel` link and pass it from `Router.resolve`.
+- [ ] Register subagents (parent call and recorded spawn) and forks with kind and parent id; tests for each.
+- [ ] Register restored sessions (root and recorded forks) from `restoreSession(id:)`; test with a recording made in the same test.
+- [ ] `close()` unregisters; a test shows the closed session is gone while the test still holds it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A new root has `kind == .root` and no parent; a subagent has `kind == .subagent` and its parent id; a fork has `kind == .fork` and its source id as parent.
+- [ ] `restoreSession(id:)` gives a session that is in the directory, and its recorded forks are too.
+- [ ] After `close()`, the session is not in the live query.
+- [ ] Sessions of two routers in one process do not appear in each other's directory.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/RouterSessionDirectoryRegistrationTests.swift` (scripted models, no real model).
+- [ ] `swift test --filter RouterSessionDirectoryRegistration` passes; the full `swift test` stays green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #session #router-api
\ No newline at end of file
